summary.en: An oncology antibody pipeline combines epcoritamab expansion with pivotal Rina-S and acquired petosemtamab programs. Royalties remain a major funding source.
summary.zh: 肿瘤抗体管线结合epcoritamab适应症拓展、关键性Rina-S项目和收购的petosemtamab项目。特许权使用费仍是主要资金来源。

ind.en: First-line diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; also other B-cell malignancies
ind.zh: 一线弥漫性大B细胞淋巴瘤;另有其他B细胞恶性肿瘤

ind.en: Platinum-resistant ovarian cancer; also endometrial cancer
ind.zh: 铂耐药卵巢癌;另有子宫内膜癌

next.en: First launch expected, subject to approval
next.zh: 预计首次上市,以获批为前提

ind.en: Head and neck cancer; also colorectal cancer

ind.zh: 实体瘤;结直肠癌联合用药项目

watch.en: October pivotal results for epcoritamab, Rina-S and petosemtamab support regulatory discussions and potential 2027 launches.
watch.zh: 10月epcoritamab、Rina-S和petosemtamab的关键结果支持监管沟通和2027年的潜在上市。

watch.en: Nine-month royalty revenue was $2.699 billion of $3.238 billion total revenue, led by DARZALEX and Kesimpta.
watch.zh: 前九个月特许权使用费收入为26.99亿美元,占总收入32.38亿美元的大部分,主要来自DARZALEX和Kesimpta。

watch.en: The Merus acquisition used $5.5 billion of borrowings plus cash.
watch.zh: 收购Merus使用了55亿美元借款及现金。

sources: Q3 2026 company presentation: current stages and guidance
ProfoundBio acquisition including Rina-S completed, May 2024
gaps: Pipeline webpage did not expose its full chart in readable text; the full Q3 pipeline table was reviewed instead.
Company phase totals were not verified.

November company presentation establishes Phase 1 for GEN1059, GEN3018, GEN1079, GEN1106 and GEN1119. GEN1059 also has a combined Phase 1/2 trial; the portfolio chart still calls its most advanced stage Phase 1. Undisclosed early targets and origins remain null. Trial completion-year estimates were not treated as company catalyst guidance.

Rina-S acquisition provenance uses the May 2024 ProfoundBio closing release, older than June 2026. Its first-launch expectation is conditional on regulatory approval; petosemtamab LiGeR-HN2 data are guided for Q1 2027. Other selected next milestones remain unverified.
